events.name: Green Bay Packers at Seattle Seahawks

headlines.description: Marshawn Lynch rushed for 110 yards and two touchdowns, Russell Wilson threw a pair of touchdown passes, and the Seattle Seahawks started defense of their Super Bowl title with a 36-16 win over the Green Bay Packers on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lynch, Seahawks pound Packers to open '14

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Atlanta Falcons

headlines.description: Matt Bryant kicked a 51-yarder field goal on the final play of regulation, then booted a 52-yarder in overtime to give the Atlanta Falcons a 37-34 victory over the New Orleans Saints.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan (448 yards), Falcons top Saints in OT

headlines.description: Fred Jackson set up Dan Carpenter's field goal in overtime with a 38-yard run to the 1, and the Buffalo Bills stunned the Chicago Bears 23-20 in the season opener Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jackson's OT run leads Bills to stun Bears

events.name: Tennessee Titans at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Jake Locker threw for 266 yards and two touchdowns, Alex Smith was intercepted three times and the Tennessee Titans rolled to a 26-10 victory over the Kansas City Chiefs on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Locker leads Titans to 26-10 win over Chiefs

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at St. Louis Rams
New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Knowshon Moreno rushed for 134 yards and a touchdown, Ryan Tannehill threw for two scores and the Miami Dolphins overpowered New England after halftime on the way to a 33-20 win over the Patriots on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins dominate in 2nd half, rally past Pats

events.name: Oakland Raiders at New York Jets

headlines.description: Defense, big Ivory run lead Jets past Raiders 19-7
headlines.shortLinkText: Ivory's big run keys Jets' win over Raiders

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw a 68-yard touchdown pass to Jeremy Maclin in the fourth quarter and the Philadelphia Eagles rallied from a 17-0 second-half deficit to beat the Jacksonville Jaguars 34-17 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Eagles rally from 17 down to get past Jags

headlines.description: Suisham's winner lifts Steelers over Browns 30-27
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers survive Browns' rally with late FG

headlines.description: Green's TD gives Bengals 23-16 win over Ravens
headlines.shortLinkText: Green's late TD lifts Bengals over Ravens

headlines.description: Rookie Alfred Blue blocked a punt and returned it for a touchdown and J.J. Watt lived up to his massive new contract to help the Houston Texans snap a 14-game losing streak with a 17-6 win over Washington on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans stifle RG III, Redskins to open season

headlines.description: Colin Kaepernick threw two touchdown passes to Vernon Davis, one right after the first of three interceptions by Tony Romo, and the San Francisco 49ers opened the season with a 28-17 win over the sloppy Dallas Cowboys on Sunday.

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Anderson throws 2 TDs, leads Panthers over Bucs
headlines.shortLinkText: Anderson helps Panthers win without Newton

headlines.description: Peyton Manning sure didn't need Wes Welker in this heart-pounding opener. He threw three touchdown passes to tight end Julius Thomas in the first half and the Denver Broncos held on to beat the Indianapolis Colts 31-24 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos cruise early, hold off late Colts rally

events.name: New York Giants at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford improvised brilliantly on two early touchdown passes to Calvin Johnson, and Detroit beat the New York Giants 35-14 on Monday night in Jim Caldwell's first game as Lions coach.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford, Lions jump out early, rock Giants

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Arizona Cardinals

headlines.description: John Brown caught a 13-yard scoring pass from Carson Palmer with 2:25 to play, and the Arizona Cardinals rallied to beat the San Diego Chargers 18-17 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Palmer, Cardinals rally to tip Chargers late
